pageContent.markdown:
Castle of Trematon, near Saltash, Cornwall

# Castle of Trematon, Cornwall

Nearly three years inside a Norman castle's Georgian heart, hanging House of Hackney prints throughout the house.

![Detail of the PLANTASIA forest mural by House of Hackney, hung by Mr Wallcover at the Castle of Trematon, Cornwall.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/trematon-01-800.webp)

## Project record

Client, materials & project facts

**Client**
: Trematon Castle

**Designer**
: –Not recorded

**Main contractor**
: –Not recorded

**Maker and paper**
: House of Hackney – PLANTASIA; House of Hackney – GAIA, Prussian Blue; House of Hackney – FLORA DELANICA; House of Hackney – COSMOS, Celestial Blue; House of Hackney – FLORA FANTASIA, Noir Stripe and Ecru; House of Hackney – ARTEMIS; House of Hackney – HOLLYHOCKS; Lincrusta heritage relief wallcovering

**Area or rooms**
: –Not recorded

**Scope**
: Wallcovering installation contractor across the Georgian house and estate

**Year**
: 2019–2022

## At a glance

- **Client:** Trematon Castle
- **Location:** Castle of Trematon, above the Lynher and Tamar near Saltash, Cornwall
- **Years:** 2019–2022. Our own site photographs run from **24 April 2019 to 7 January 2022**
- **Role:** Wallcovering installation across the house and estate
- **Wallcoverings:** House of Hackney [PLANTASIA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/plantasia-wallpaper-sage), [GAIA Prussian Blue](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/gaia-wallpaper-prussian-blue), [FLORA DELANICA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/flora-delanica-wallpaper-clay), [COSMOS](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/cosmos-wallpaper-celestial-blue), [FLORA FANTASIA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/flora-fantasia-wallpaper-noir-stripe), [ARTEMIS](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/artemis-wallpaper-petrol), [HOLLYHOCKS](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/hollyhocks-wallpaper-summer), plus heritage [Lincrusta](https://www.lincrusta.com/) relief
- **Scope:** strip-out and wall preparation, lining, papered ceilings including the atrium ceiling around its oval lantern, large-scale mural setting-out, pattern-matched full-height drops in bedrooms, bathrooms and a powder room, and laser-aligned Lincrusta relief

## The castle

Trematon is a Norman motte-and-bailey castle, built in 1068 and granted to the Duchy of Cornwall in 1337. The Duchy still owns it today. A 13th-century gatehouse still guards the bailey. Within the walls, an 11,000 sq ft Georgian manor with nine bedrooms was added in the early 1800s, its windows looking out over nine acres of gardens and the estuary beyond.

The house has beautiful proportions, and it needed a lot of restoration: paint stripped back to a blank canvas, then a multi-year, foundational renovation. Trematon is also the setting of House of Hackney’s campaigns and gives its name to the TREMATONIA print.

## The brief

To hang House of Hackney wallpapers across the Georgian house. That meant large-scale murals, densely drawn florals and ceiling-to-ceiling “print drenching”, in a house where every wall is a little out of true and every ceiling a little out of level.

## Our approach

**Strip-out and preparation.** Our photographs from 2019 and early 2020 show rooms taken back to bare plaster, old finishes scraped off and the atrium stripped and lined. Reinforced lining materials (Wallrock and Anaglypta cartons appear on site in June 2019) were used to give the hand-printed papers a true, stable ground.

**Ceilings as a fifth wall.** Several rooms were papered overhead. That includes the skylit atrium, where the print had to be cut around a decorative oval lantern and a chandelier rose, and the small box room, papered on all four walls and the ceiling.

**Murals and setting-out.** PLANTASIA is a panoramic forest landscape that does not forgive an error. Each drop was set out to plan, and photographs from June 2020 show the crew working on ladders across the full height of the room.

**Pattern and seam control.** Digitally printed papers in deep, saturated colours were batch-checked from the roll labels, and pattern matches were carried across corners, chimney breasts and door heads.

**Heritage relief.** In November 2021 the team installed Lincrusta, the embossed heritage wallcovering made since 1877. Panels were laid out on the table, then hung to a laser line for perfect vertical alignment.

**Living house, long programme.** The work ran in phases between 2019 and 2022, around a family home, a working estate and a house that was opening its doors to guests.

## Materials

- **[PLANTASIA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/plantasia-wallpaper-sage)**: panoramic forest-landscape mural
- **[GAIA – Prussian Blue](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/gaia-wallpaper-prussian-blue)**
- ** [FLORA DELANICA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/flora-delanica-wallpaper-clay)** (Clay) (identified from our site photographs)
- **[COSMOS – Celestial Blue](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/cosmos-wallpaper-celestial-blue)** (identified from our site photographs)
- **[FLORA FANTASIA – Noir Stripe](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/flora-fantasia-wallpaper-noir-stripe)** (identified from our site photographs)
- **[FLORA FANTASIA – Ecru](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/flora-fantasia-wallpaper-ecru)** (identified from our site photographs)
- **[ARTEMIS](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/artemis-wallpaper-petrol)** (Petrol / [Blush](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/artemis-wallpaper-blush)) (identified from our site photographs)
- **[HOLLYHOCKS](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/hollyhocks-wallpaper-summer)** (identified from our site photographs)
- **[Lincrusta](https://www.lincrusta.com/)** heritage relief (not House of Hackney)

Other House of Hackney designs that the press records at Trematon, but which we have **not** matched to our photos: [FLORALIA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/floralia-wallpaper-ecru) (bedroom, per AD), [GALANTHI](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/galanthi-wallpaper-viridis) (guest bedroom, per AD) and [PHANTASIA – Selenite Orange](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/phantasia-wallpaper-selenite-orange) (powder room, per AD). The brand’s [TREMATONIA](https://www.houseofhackney.com/products/trematonia-wallpaper-ecru) print is named after the castle; we have not seen it in our photos.

*Since we completed, some rooms have been refreshed with newer House of Hackney designs. Today’s interiors will not all match our photographs.*

## More from site

The later photographs on this page are our own, first posted on our Instagram, [@mrwallcover](https://www.instagram.com/mrwallcover/), between June 2019 and November 2021: the house and the castle walls, rooms during strip-out, finished bedrooms and bathrooms, the caravan papered and fitted out to a House of Hackney design in May 2021, and the Lincrusta going up the curved stair walls in November 2021 ([see the post](https://www.instagram.com/p/CWksjiaKBnq/)), set out panel by panel with a laser line ([see the post](https://www.instagram.com/p/CW5IdnPKgTP/)).

## Outcome

A Georgian house within a Norman castle, dressed wall by wall and ceiling by ceiling in the prints of the brand that lives there, across nearly three years of phased work. For a wallcovering contractor there are few sterner tests than hanging a designer’s own paper in the designer’s own home.

How the commission ran

## The same standards, on every commission.

Each commission has a written scope by room, walls prepared until they are true, protected floors, batch and shade control, set-out from the room’s focal points, and a return visit. [Read the method](https://www.mrwallcover.com/practice/#method).

The six standards in full

01

### Survey and scope, room by room

We measure the wall that will actually be hung, allow for the repeat and the wastage, and write a scope of works room by room before anyone orders paper.

02

### Preparation decides the finish

Walls are filled, made good and primed until they are true. If a wall is not ready for the material specified, we say so before the last drop is ordered.

03

### Protection and containment

Floors, furniture and finished joinery are protected as part of the hang. Work is contained and the place is left tidy each evening. In a home we are visitors; in a hotel we work around the house.

04

### Batch and shade control

Deliveries are checked against the measure, and batches and shading are managed so that a corridor of rooms reads as one surface.

05

### Set out from the room's focal points

Pattern is set out from chimneypieces, doorcases and bed walls, so the pattern sits square to the cornice and the joinery.

06

### One team, then the return visit

The people who start are the people who finish. Four to six weeks after completion we come back to look at every seam and edge, and the workmanship is guaranteed for twelve months.

[See the finish up close: seams, internal corners, edges and joins from our own installations](https://www.mrwallcover.com/details/)

By [Dorin Burcus](https://www.mrwallcover.com/about/#dorin), founder · Last updated 22 October 2026
